subject: science
concept: Observing that solids have their own shape while liquids take the shape of their container
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Physical Science Disciplinary Core Ideas — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student pours a liquid into containers of different shapes and observes it changing shape, then does the same with a solid
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a substance to a picture predicting its shape in a new container
exercise.abstract: Student predicts whether a described substance will keep or change its shape in a new container

misconception_flags: assumes a solid will change shape like a liquid when moved to a new container

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
